title: Spot winged Drosophila fruit fly on cherry

Header: Spot winged Drosophila fruit fly on cherry

Prevention: Timely remove dropped infected or rotten fruits, which are on the ground.
Collect them together, cover with plastic housing and then expose to sun for 1 week
Clean weeds and residues before cherry trees sprout
Harvest timely when the cherry get ripen and make sure most of the cherry trees are harvested at same time.
Netting each tree with mesh size of 1*1 mm or 1*1.6 can protect cherries from damage.
Monitoring: Make traps out of plastic yogurt containers that have a lid.
Drill 10-16 holes that are 3/16 inch in diameter around the upper side of the container for fly entry.
Add sugar: vinegar: fruit wine: orange juice: water = 1.5:1:1:1:10, each can be bought from supermarket)
Traps should be in the field when fruits begin colouring.
Place 1 trap per orchard; 1-2 meters from the ground.
Check the trap weekly for small < ½ a cm flies with dark spots on the tip of their wings floating in the fluid.
Change the trap liquid once a week.
Treatment: action should be considered at 10 to 20 adults per trap per week which indicates a threatening population to the crop.
Direct Control: Hang three insect lamps traps (DT-15R projection lamp from
Taobao) per medium size cherry orchard.
Use traps sugar: vinegar: fruit wine: orange juice: water = 1.5:1:1:1:10 liquid into 1/3 of the container to trap the fruit flies. 1 trap per tree.
Harvested fruits should be processed within 4 days at low temperature (<=1.7°C), to kill the larva and egg in cherry
Restrictions: When using a pesticide or botanical, always wear protective clothing and follow the instructions on the product label.
Always consult recent list of registered pesticides http:// www.chinapesticide.gov.cn/
WHO III (slightly hazardous), Use at the beginning of the pests damage.
No more than two applications; 28 days between 2 applications.
WHO II (moderately hazardous), High risk to bees, very toxic to aquatic organisms.
PHI: 14 days, Max 2 sprays per season.
Spray far away from fishes, poultry and honey bees.
Only use when buprofezin was used too often.
